messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, Lydia Chang <lydia@nuware.io>, Ethan Cole <ethan@atlascloud.com>
Cc: 
Date: Sat, 26 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Account Reconciliation: Partner Alliance Pipeline & Territory Sync

Folks —

Quick note to kick off a short reconciliation across NuWave/AtlasCloud accounts that have appeared in both partner and direct pipelines. We found overlap on a handful of enterprise logos while prepping Q4 forecast and want a clear, documented ownership map before SDR/AE outreach resumes.

Attached: nuwave_account_list.csv (raw list from partner), territory-map-v2.pdf (our current territory boundaries), and a draft owners workbook.

Proposed goals for this thread:
- Agree on owner-by-account (Partner vs Redwood direct) for any overlap > $50k ARR.
- Define a short-term tie-breaker rule for disputed accounts (see option A/B below).
- Schedule a 30-min sync Tuesday (Camila/Marcus/Sergio + partner reps) to sign off.

Option A (preferred, minimal ops): If the partner has an intro/active opp in last 180 days, partner owns for 6 months; Redwood will handoff/unassign until review.
Option B (strict quota protection): Ownership goes to the pipeline owner with the most advanced opportunity stage; partner gets referral credit if Redwood closes.

Lydia/Ethan — please confirm the attached partner roster is complete and flag any accounts you believe should be excluded or require co-sell.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Partnerships (Americas)
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- nuwave_account_list.csv (CSV, 1.2 MB)
- territory-map-v2.pdf (PDF, 680 KB)
- MAP-owners-proposal.xlsx (Excel, 240 KB)

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, Lydia Chang <lydia@nuware.io>, Ethan Cole <ethan@atlascloud.com>

Date: Sat, 26 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Account Reconciliation: Partner Alliance Pipeline & Territory Sync

Kimberly —

Thanks for pulling this together. A couple of quick clarifications from sales ops perspective:

1) Threshold: can we set the ownership threshold at $75k ARR to avoid micromanaging small deals?
2) Historical depth: 180 days is reasonable, but we should also check for any active POC or signed MOU irrespective of date.
3) Escalation: propose a lightweight "escrow" where disputed accounts are assigned to a neutral CS owner for 30 days while partners/AE coordinate.

I took the attached CSV and ran a de-dup on company domains — there are 9 overlaps flagged as "high-risk" by pipeline value and renewal windows. I can drop a short owners table in an update.

On Tuesday I'll be available 10:00–11:30 PT; Marcus/Sergio, can you confirm? Lydia/Ethan, if you can have your account lists reconciled by EOD Monday that will make the sync productive.

Subject: Re: Account Reconciliation: Partner Alliance Pipeline & Territory Sync

Thanks, Kimberly and team —

We pulled our live roster and attached NuWave-current-opps.xlsx. Notes from our side:
- We have active POCs at GoldenByte Labs, Meridian Health, and Cyfren Systems (all in the >$100k ARR range). Intros were within the last 120 days.
- GoldenByte and Meridian were introduced directly by NuWave and have a signed non-binding MOU for a pilot.
- Cyfren has some procurement constraints and requested vendor references — we expect 30–45 day buying window.

We support Option A but request a co-sell clause for any Redwood-led technical demos where NuWave was the original introducer. Also, for any disputed accounts where partners have an MOU, we request a mandatory 45-day hold for partner-first outreach.

Happy to walk through the sheet on Tuesday. EOD Monday is tight but we can send a cleaned domains list by COB Monday.

Best,
Lydia Chang
VP Strategic Partnerships
NuWave Analytics

Attachments:
- NuWave-current-opps.xlsx (Excel, 180 KB)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, Lydia Chang <lydia@nuware.io>, Ethan Cole <ethan@atlascloud.com>

Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Account Reconciliation: Partner Alliance Pipeline & Territory Sync

Team —

I ran a reconciliation in the shared Drive (see link) and put together a recommended owners table based on ARR, intro date, and MOU status. Summary below (full table in Drive):

- GoldenByte Labs — Owner: NuWave (MOU + pilot, intro 07/2026)
- Meridian Health — Owner: NuWave (POC active, intro 08/2026)
- Cyfren Systems — Co-sell (Redwood AE + NuWave) with partner-first outreach window 30 days
- Spectrum Works — Owner: Redwood (partner intro > 240 days, no active opp)
- Parallax Inc. — Owner: Redwood (enterprise renewal in 2027, direct AE engagement)

My tie-break rules used (applied in order):
1) Signed MOU or pilot commitment = partner owner.
2) Intro within last 180 days with an active opp = partner owner for 90 days.
3) Otherwise, owner is Redwood if AE has active opportunity stage > Proposal.

Action items:
- Camila: confirm owners table and update territory-map-v2.pdf to reflect co-sell accounts (due EOD).
- Lydia/Ethan: confirm you’re OK with the 30–45 day partner-first window on disputed accounts.
- Sergio: please check quota assignments for affected AEs (I flagged 3 reps).

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b-PartnerMaps

Marcus Lin
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- MAP-owners-proposal.xlsx (Excel, revised, 255 KB)

Nice work, team. We have alignment on the key accounts and the tie-break rules Marcus documented. Final decisions:

- Accept Marcus' tie-break rules (1–3) as the canonical policy for this reconciliation exercise.
- Ownership assignments in the Drive are now official for Q4; partners will have partner-first windows as noted (NuWave: 45 days where MOU exists; 30 days for active opps).
- Camila: please push the updated territory map to the partner portal and notify partner account teams by EOD Wednesday.
- Sergio: work with sales compensation to handle referral credit for any Redwood-close on partner-owned accounts (assign interim tracking code: REF-NUW-0926).

Lydia/Ethan — appreciate the quick turn. If either of you want the exec summary doc for your leadership, Marcus can pull a 1-pager.

Kimberly Park
Head of Partnerships (Americas)
Redwood Inference
